denominator_or_basis: Positive catalogue of that population; not native alert count
interpretation_limit: Qualified witness union; descriptive/pending/coverage-unavailable populations are not general recall.
object_count_before minus object_count_after; same identity can survive while artifact occurrences disappear.

denominator_or_basis: Supported artifact occurrences before stored-output omission
interpretation_limit: supported_before minus supported_after for occurrence populations. No shortened pipeline was executed.

denominator_or_basis: Previously supported set R, not the full reference catalogue
interpretation_limit: rho=|retained supported instances intersect R|/|R|. Representative results can be a range; undefined if denominator is zero.

denominator_or_basis: Pairs placed together by the grouping key, within one comparable population
interpretation_limit: A within-group pair is incorrect when its two reference_id values differ. Terraform: one 12-alert group gives 66 pairs minus 12 same-resource pairs =54; four 3-alert resource groups give 0. Pair observations are not independent vulnerabilities.

denominator_or_basis: 11 resolved false native alerts per condition/pass
interpretation_limit: Seven Java source cases; no general population false-positive rate.

denominator_or_basis: 62 resolved true native alerts per condition/pass
interpretation_limit: Separate from the 15 literal declarations; four total Q-C dismissals are not four true-native-alert losses.
No negative declarations in this triage cohort.

unit: positive cases losing every supporting alert
interpretation_limit: Case support is a union of witnesses; alert loss need not equal case loss.
Abstention conservatively retains the alert and is not an explicit retain decision.
Invalid and absent outputs retain the original alert; invalid is reported separately, not double-counted as valid retain.
(Completed retain + completed dismiss)/88. Does not treat conservative fallback as model commitment.

denominator_or_basis: One static profile invocation; five blocks
interpretation_limit: Includes invocation/isolation and writes; input/database copying and hash checks excluded.

denominator_or_basis: Dynamic scanner command phase; five jobs per profile
interpretation_limit: Not target startup or full job wall time. Compile and target generation are separate recorded phases.

denominator_or_basis: One scientific model request; 88 per condition/pass
interpretation_limit: Warmup/startup/lifecycle overhead excluded; latency total is the sum of recorded request intervals.

denominator_or_basis: Sampled peak per static invocation; bytes/1024^2
interpretation_limit: Sampled rather than exact continuous peak; Docker daemon excluded. KICS measures a client and scanner memory is not measured.

denominator_or_basis: Maximum sampled model-server RSS over scientific requests; KiB/1024^2
interpretation_limit: RSS includes shared/file-backed pages; not interchangeable with cgroup usage.

denominator_or_basis: Maximum sampled cgroup current usage over scientific requests; bytes/1024^3
interpretation_limit: Different accounting boundary from RSS. Not a sum of independent resource requirements.

denominator_or_basis: Per profile/block; inventory distinguished from detector output
interpretation_limit: Native units vary by tool. Syft findings=0 is not zero components; component inventory is separately recorded. Never sum as unique vulnerabilities.
